# rand-engine

> Python + NumPy library that generates synthetic data very fast from a declarative spec (a dict of column -> method + kwargs): pandas DataFrames, infinite dict streams, csv/json/parquet files, Spark DataFrames, and related tables through `pk`/`fk` key columns. Seeded per generator; Faker pools compose on top.

## Docs

<!-- derived-from: public-api sha256:889c68fd0f20 -->

- [README](https://github.com/marcoaureliomenezes/rand_engine/blob/master/README.md): landing page with install, a 30-second example, when to use it, the five get-started cases and the docs links
- [Getting started](https://marcoaureliomenezes.github.io/rand_engine/getting-started/): install and the first spec
- [DataGenerator](https://marcoaureliomenezes.github.io/rand_engine/1_DATA_GENERATOR/): every method and its kwargs, float rules, `null_rate` / `anomaly_rate`, seeds, `stream_dict`
- [SparkGenerator](https://marcoaureliomenezes.github.io/rand_engine/2_SPARK_GENERATOR/): the same spec on Spark
- [Writing files](https://marcoaureliomenezes.github.io/rand_engine/3_WRITING_FILES/): `write`, `writeStream`, formats and accepted options
- [Keys](https://marcoaureliomenezes.github.io/rand_engine/4_CONSTRAINTS/): `pk` and `fk` columns
- [Reference](https://marcoaureliomenezes.github.io/rand_engine/reference/): the public API, one canonical entry per object
- [Explanation](https://marcoaureliomenezes.github.io/rand_engine/explanation/): the RandSpec model and the NumPy core

## Tutorials

- [Test data](https://marcoaureliomenezes.github.io/rand_engine/tutorials/test-data/): a DataFrame for pipeline tests with nulls and anomalies
- [Lake](https://marcoaureliomenezes.github.io/rand_engine/tutorials/lake/): pk/fk related tables written to a Parquet lake
- [Kafka](https://marcoaureliomenezes.github.io/rand_engine/tutorials/kafka/): an event stream for Kafka
- [Databricks](https://marcoaureliomenezes.github.io/rand_engine/tutorials/databricks/): a Spark/Databricks notebook on SparkGenerator
- [Faker](https://marcoaureliomenezes.github.io/rand_engine/tutorials/faker/): Faker pools sampled at NumPy speed

## Agent skill and case files

- [kafka case](https://github.com/marcoaureliomenezes/rand_engine/blob/master/rand_engine/cases/kafka.py.txt): the Kafka event-stream example

- [faker case](https://github.com/marcoaureliomenezes/rand_engine/blob/master/rand_engine/cases/faker.py.txt): Faker pools through RandSpecs.faker_pool
